target: Construct CFR(5,27), a5x27 circular Florentine rectangle; same-lane alternate CFR(6,21) only after decision or concrete exhausted/bounded models and an exact-group prior-art screen.
definition: Rows are permutations of Z_n. For every ordered distinct symbols a,b and distance m in1..n-1, at most one row has pos(b)-pos(a) == m mod n.

open_attestation.known_dev: CPro1 dev list includes CFR(3,33), CFR(4,27), CFR(5,21). CFR(5,25) was claimed by Kirtchakov Aug6,2026 and is not a target.

pre_freeze_screen.result: No cyclic(Z27,6;1)-DM / CFR5,27 found in readable scope. Sage GF27 entry is elementary-abelian additive(Z3)^3, not applicable. Song2000, several Handbook sections, Evans sources and other cited papers were blocked; a miss is not novelty.

initial_representation.equivalence: After symbol relabelling set first positional permutation f0=id; independently rotate each row so fi(0)=0. CFR iff every fi is a permutation and fi-fj is a permutation of Z_n for every pair (position maps, then invert each to output rows).
initial_representation.primary_restricted_model: odd position maps fi(-a)=-fi(a). For n=2m+1 each fi is a signed permutation of1..m; each pairwise difference on1..m is nonzero and hits each absolute residue class once. SAT with one-hot positions and one-hot pair-difference auxiliaries; avoid enumerating all odd permutations.
initial_representation.positive_control: Kirtchakov CFR(5,25), whose K=<7> equivariance includes -1; convert to position maps and verify odd model. Also CPro1 CFR(3,33)/(4,27) if public witnesses can be fetched/read-only/pinned.
initial_representation.other_models: Before larger multiplier-equivalent searches, test the size of every subgroup fixed set: e.g. if it forces all rows to permute {0,11,22} at n33, this may bound the restricted family to<=2 rows; do not mistake that for unrestricted nonexistence.
